format: one dispatched record per non-null far pointer; 8x16 glyph rows; optional runtime-tested 0x0800 line break; 0x80LL/0xC0LL length terminator

dispatch_safety.third_line_policy: 0x0800 is allowed only in the final record of a group whose total remains at most three physical rows; null dispatch separators are never consumed
